essence: The speaker is bound to the supreme goddess by affection and devotion.
The practitioner should then perform breath-control and the six-limbed ritual by ritual power.
One should give her an offering with the remnant red substance every day.
One should worship her daily with body, mind, and speech.
After giving a delightful offering, one should recite the mantra until midnight.
